title: Re-brand a finished template
what_it_does: Protocol: capture brand with hyperframes capture, fill story slots, change only copy, colour, marks, type and icons, never frame numbers or eases, re-measure text widths after render, plus a list of known traps (expo.out is not custom EO, clip boundaries just below frame time, no idle motion).
when_to_use: When a person wants their launch video from a template; becomes the template's agent brief.
why: The best-written part of the repo and Apache-2.0, keep the NOTICE attribution. Strip HeyGen-specific wording when copied.
